{{Quote|She died in my arms. You should've seen what those filth did to her.|Saylew|<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] member of the [[Pilgrims]] religion was the '''wife''' of a fellow Pilgrim named [[Saylew]], and the two lived in [[Kalikori village]] on their adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] with the native [[Flesh Raider]]s<ref name="High-Tech Savages" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> Saylew's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a Flesh Raider [[Attack on Kalikori village|attack]] on the village. Her death greatly affected Saylew, who had held her body as she died, and his grief caused him to confront the village leaders about their failure to protect the village and his desire for revenge.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saylew's wife was mentioned in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "High-Tech Savages" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="High-Tech Savages" />
